# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Government Services and Facilities | Sole Proprietorship: Facilities support contractor

| | |

| Scope at this tier | Primary regulation that applies to the owner |
| Expected depth | Requirement-level checklist; self-attested evidence |

| Universal method | [step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md](../../../../00_universal-framework/projects/step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md) |

**Regulation to analyze:** NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (Release 5.2.0) control baseline, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (Release 5.2.0, Aug 27, 2025)
**Why:** It is the common control catalog underpinning FISMA (federal facilities), IRS Pub 1075, CJIS v6 and GovRAMP. Election offices should overlay the VVSG 2.0 security requirements. Education Facilities should use the n61 target (GLBA Safeguards / FERPA).
